title: RecRSI: Mechanism-Guided Discovery of Recommendation Algorithms
summary: RecRSI uses an LLM research framework to propose recommendation-algorithm changes, test them and carry evidence into subsequent experiments. Across four starting recommenders and four datasets, it reported average relative gains over the strongest competing results of 2.60% in NDCG@5 and 2.20% in HR@5; these are offline evaluations.
ai_technology: Mechanism-guided agentic search for recommendation algorithms
organization: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Fudan University; Meituan
